QuestInfo.name: Make a Octopus & Mushroom Omok Set
QuestInfo.0: It seems #p228# in #m010001050# can make another type of Omok Set.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p228##k in #m010001050# said he could make a new type of Omok Set if I brought him a few items. He said I can easily get them by defeating #o6#, #o9#, and #o12#, found around #m10001000# and #m10003000#. I should try to gather them when I have the time.
QuestInfo.2: I brought the requested items to #p228# in #m010001050# and received a #b#t4080004##k! With this, I can play the Omok mini-game with other adventurers anywhere! I should remember to ask #p228# if I want to know more about the mini-game.

0.0: Hey there! Are you enjoying the mini games? I can make a new Omok Set if you gather a few items for me. How about it, want to give it a try?

yes.0: Good! To make a #t4080004#, I need one of each of the following: #b#t4031058##k, #b#t4031059##k, and #b#t4031060##k. You should be able to get them easily by defeating #o6#, #o9#, and #o12#, found around #m10001000# and #m10003000#, so please bring them to me. I'll be waiting for you right here.

no.0: Hey, sometimes you just need to take a break and look around! If you change your mind, talk to me anytime.

1.0: You've gathered everything I asked for! That couldn't have been easy--you're amazing! All right! Time for me to show off my skills! Just wait a moment. I'll craft your #b#t4080004##k in no time. Heave-ho!

yes.0: You got your #b#t4080004##k, right? You can use this item anywhere in Maple World to open a mini-game room and have fun with others. If you achieve a high score, something great is sure to happen. I'll be cheering you on from here, so give it your best shot!
yes.1: Oh, right. If you ever have any questions about Omok, just ask me anytime. I plan on staying here for a while. Now then, go on and try hard to become the ultimate mini-game champion, to surpass even me! Though... that's probably not going to happen. Anyway... I'm busy, so I'll see you later.
